purpose: Keep four Maryland psychiatric hospital CCNs separate from a cached state-domain root pointer that redirects to another program and names only two chronic hospitals.
source_scope: Previously retained pointer bytes were reused; no new root-pointer retrieval is claimed by this review.

first_party_facilities_page.distinction: Lists the four reviewed hospitals under Inpatient Psychiatric Hospital Centers, and Deer's Head and Western Maryland under Chronic Hospitals.

latest_eastern_shore_browser_recheck.reason_for_repeat: Continuation audit of the unresolved Tier-2 facility-specific pointer/file gate.
latest_eastern_shore_browser_recheck.browser_result: The current Maryland Department of Health page renders Eastern Shore Hospital Center as a CMS-certified psychiatric facility at 5262 Woods Road, Cambridge, MD 21613. It exposes facility information and resources but no price-transparency page, cms-hpt.txt link, or machine-readable-file link.
latest_eastern_shore_browser_recheck.interpretation: This strengthens current first-party identity and address evidence, but does not recover an MRF or authorize reuse of the Western Maryland/Deers Head pointer. CCN 214002 remains unresolved pending a facility-specific pointer/file or publisher clarification.

limits: The cached pointer is a bounded observation of one root response. Absence of these names there does not establish that no facility-specific MRF exists elsewhere, and no legal-compliance conclusion is made. Current per-facility price pages, alternate authorized hosting domains and file metadata remain unverified.
